aplicacao_citacao: Abstract p.1: 'advances in high-performance construction material development' - argamassas AAM de laboratorio (prismas 40x40x160), sem elemento/obra; Sec.2.3.5 p.4 compara com 'a CEM I 42.5 N mortar ... similar strength class'
nota: Texto integral lido (13 pp, ate as referencias). Nenhuma vida util em anos. Unicas mencoes: Sec.3.2 p.9 'long-term material alterations during its expected service life ... are not considered in this study' (sem valor) e '>70 years' = idade da escoria OHF em aterro (nao e vida util). GWP cradle-to-gate; Tabelas A2/A3 so no material suplementar externo.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec. LCA p.3: 'The first functional unit was one ton of binder ... the second was one cubic meter of concrete'; cradle to gate, 'the stages of casting, construction, use, deconstruction/demolition of the structure ... were not included'. Cura 'good curing is close to curing a cast-in-place concrete structure, while excellent curing corresponds a precast element' e so analogia de cura.
nota: Confirma a nota de 2026-09-19: nenhum valor de vida util em anos no artigo inteiro (nem proprio nem citado). Service life so qualitativa (indices A de Gettu et al. 'correlated to service life'; fib Bulletin 34 usado so para converter Dnssm em Dcl). Carbonatacao medida aos 36 meses de exposicao, sem extrapolacao a vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3 p.6: 'three grades were selected (40, 60, and 100 MPa) to cover a wide range of concrete that can be used for different purposes' - descreve usos tipicos por classe (40 MPa 'common for most structural uses'; 60 MPa 'commonly used in high-rise buildings ... columns on lower floors'; 100 MPa 'lightweight structures or structural components ... exposed to severe environments'), sem aplicacao propria do estudo.
nota: Texto integral lido. Zero ocorrencias de service life/lifespan/anos de vida. Usos por classe sao descricao generica, nao a aplicacao do estudo; se a Kie preferir aplicar por par, a classe 60 MPa (pares 299/300) e associada pelo artigo a edificios altos.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1.1 p.2: 'A two-story building was selected as case study ... The buildings modeled were 2 x 2 bay hypothetical office buildings, two stories tall'; paredes impressas em 3D (exteriores ocas e interiores macicas) com KCSC (Mix-1..3), nao estruturais ao nivel do edificio e tambem paredes portantes ao nivel do componente.
nota: Texto integral lido. So 3 ocorrencias de 'year' no artigo, nenhuma de vida util. LCA cradle-to-gate (FU = edificio inteiro / volume de betao / volume x fc28), sem fase de uso nem vida util.

aplicacao_citacao: Introducao p.2: 'This compressive strength is set to be 50 MPa. This is to represent concrete used for dense high strength structural applications such as in high-rise buildings (Levy, 2012)'; Sec.2 p.6: 'The 50 MPa compressive strength was chosen to representative dense high-strength concrete for high-rise building applications'. FU = '1 m3 of concrete block with a 50 MPa compressive strength'.
nota: Texto integral lido. Zero ocorrencias de 'year' no artigo; nenhuma vida util. Durabilidade so: 'Ideally, durability must also be considered. However, there are no models yet that quantify the durability of geopolymers'. Aplicacao e a representada pela escolha dos 50 MPa (edificios altos), dita explicitamente pelo artigo.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.8 p.6: 'The selected functional unit for analysis was one cubic meter of the concrete, and the system boundary considered was from gate-to-gate'; estudo de laboratorio (cubos/cilindros) com otimizacao RSM; Sec.6 pede 'practical application rather than laboratory results'.
nota: Texto integral lido. 4 ocorrencias de 'year' (producao de betao/aco/escoria por ano), nenhuma vida util. A unica mencao a pavimentos refere o uso historico de RCA em 'pavements of roads or pedestrian paths' (introducao), nao a aplicacao do estudo.

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.3.3 p.5: 'Standard and high grades of concrete ... are broadly suitable for domestic and industrial construction applications including pavements and structural slabs. The functional unit adopted was a cubic metre.'
nota: Texto integral lido. Nenhuma vida util no corpo; 'service life' so em titulos de referencias (Bucher 2017, Nath 2018). As 8 ocorrencias de 'year' sao da Tabela A1 (MtCO2-eq/ano). A aplicacao e dupla e generica (edificio domestico/industrial + pavimento), por isso nao_definida; se for preciso escolher, o artigo menciona 'structural slabs' e 'pavements' ao mesmo nivel. Base de dados de resistencia de Celik et al. 2015 (SCC).

aplicacao_citacao: Abstract p.1: 'Cement-stabilised subbases provide superior bearing capacity and durability to road pavements ... This research compares alternative binders to Portland cement'; Conclusoes: 'The scope of this study is limited to an evaluation of the binding phase of stabilised recycled aggregates used in subbase pavement layers'.
nota: Texto integral lido. Zero ocorrencias de 'year' e de 'service' no artigo; nenhuma vida util. FU = 1 m3 de ligante (pasta), cradle-to-gate. Aplicacao: sub-base estabilizada de pavimento rodoviario (camada de pavimento, nao betao de pavimento de superficie).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1 p.2-3: 'The scope of this LCA study was limited to cradle-to-gate due to a lack of relevant data regarding the usage and performance of the proposed self-healing method. The functional unit was taken to be 1 m3 of concrete blocks with 50 MPa compressive strength.'
nota: Texto integral lido. Nenhuma vida util em anos; 'life span' so qualitativo ('extended life span and reduced maintenance'; 'ascertain how much improvement the self-healing process can contribute to the entire life span of the concrete block'). As 4 ocorrencias de 'year' estao nas referencias. Ao contrario do GARCES 2022 (3087), este artigo nao associa os 50 MPa a edificios ('building' com zero ocorrencias).

aplicacao_citacao: Sec.2.1 p.2-3: laje macica de betao armado 4x4 m, 12 cm, dimensionada pela NBR 6118 com cargas da 'Brazilian standard of loads for the building structures' (subpiso e revestimento ceramico); exposicao 'indoor ... sheltered from the rain'; NBR 15575 'considers the structure as a non-maintainable building part'; Tabela 5: 'Slab frame of conventional reinforced concrete structures in multi-stored building'.
nota: A Tabela 4 imprime directamente a vida util prevista (a nota de 19/09 dizia que a tabela vinha corrompida e derivou os valores de custo/ano da Tabela 5). Valores gravados: 1852 = 48.6 (correcto, impresso 48.62); 1853 = 76 (impresso 75.96, arredondado); 1854 = 109.5 ERRADO (impresso 109.38; o 109.5 veio da divisao 604.19/5.52). A linha 841 (rotulada 'cobrimento variavel', mas com o CO2 do cenario 15 mm = 897 kg / 1,64 m3 desde a correccao de 07/10) nao tem vida util gravada: o artigo da 27.35 anos para 15 mm; o rotulo 'material' e o durabilidade_resumo da 841 estao desactualizados. Vidas uteis de norma citadas (nao premissa propria): Sec.3.1 'The standards usually require, as a normal structure service life, a minimum period of 50 years, but some standards (CEN 2004; NZS 2006; JSCE 2007; EHE 2011) can require 100 years' e Sec.3.2 '50 years ... minimum cover of 20 mm ... 100 years ... 30 mm'. O 'declarada' de topo refere o cenario base (15 mm, linha 841); usar declarada_por_par.
